title: iris stricta
intro: Iris stricta, commonly known as the strict iris, is a species of flowering plant in the iris family (Iridaceae). This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, as well as therapeutic actions like wound healing and antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of Iris stricta include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. The therapeutic actions of Iris stricta make it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions, including skin infections and wounds.
